decision: Proceed with the authorized renderer-priority change; no source completeness or quality clearance.
invariants: Keep query interpretation, candidate acquisition/admission, hard scope/environment/version/session/privacy/deletion/history checks, source caps, providers and state untouched.
Protect first fitting execution/report in existing requested source order and under existing role allowances. Do not turn first-role protection into an unlimited reservation.

Offer complete admitted user originals before additional native/report groups. Neutral sources retain count3 and min(1800,budget//3) allowance; fuller representation does not add sources or override guards.

One plan owns cached actual serialized nodes, direct quotation registry, exact remaining budget and final omission costs. Retire obsolete hidden reservations so selected and neutral lanes do not charge the same emitted group twice.

Full-versus-contained-partial body reuse requires exact same source/field/role/tool identity, consistent text and offsets. The partial association retains its own canonical item, derived text, uncertainty, scope, custody and history qualifiers. Sharing quotation provenance does not share truth or currentness.
Body and tool output remain distinct citation fields. A deferred body quote is either independently displayed/citable or explicitly omitted; its matching output does not create a body catalog entry.
Canonical native command/full output/exit/tool identity remains atomic. Never admit an output-only fragment, dangling quote_ref or implicitly grounded association.

Count every rejected whole group and omitted association accurately without double counting deferred candidates that later fit. Include escaped quotation text, roots, coverage, separators and exact marker sizes within each owner budget.
fairness_and_tradeoffs: The public red case demonstrates a fitting user constraint displaced by additional admitted executions; protecting it after the first proof is a defensible general priority policy.

A question comparing several executions or historical results may need a second native result more than another original user clause. The new priority cannot promise a complete answer for such questions; preserve requested source ordering and expose/report omitted proof.

An unfit first group must not prevent later fitting groups, but omission must remain explicit. Do not silently label a later fitting result earliest/latest because an earlier requested group failed fit.
Raw user completeness is not semantic requirement classification. Preserving the whole admitted source may transport irrelevant text; it cannot establish current applicability.
required_checks: Public red becomes green at2900 while first execution remains complete; add exact-fit/one-below and6000 controls.
Test both first-role protection allowances and a multi-execution question with requested earliest/latest order; report any deferred necessary native/report interval.
Full custody versus selected partial in both input orders, conflicting uncertainty/history/scope and exact quote_ref offsets; no qualifier inheritance.
Distinct body/output catalogs, unknown tools, complete native groups and dangling-ref absence at tiny and split-owner budgets.
Disclosed replay reports all prior user/native/report interval losses and gains, not only total mirrors or gold coverage; no scoring or fixture-specific priority.
evidence_limits: Reviewed design, current rendering seam and public tests/log only. No new sealed input or grade read, replay query, Store operation or native/model call.
The11-test red receipt has one reproduced public-design failure; it is not independent answer-quality evidence.
No production source edited. Implementation still requires focused review, central tests and independent evaluation.
